notes:
Summary: Stratiform is building a real-time personalization layer for on-site product recommendations and chat-guided discovery. Primary constraint: sub-200ms p95 for end-to-end recommendation + rerank pipeline (~150ms target). High sensitivity to per-token cost; they expect heavy short requests (avg seq len ~40 tokens) but a long tail of longer sessions for assisted shopping. Interested in Redwood's Dedicated offering + private VPC for EU residency.

Technical requirements / asks (engineer notes):
- Latency targets: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 150ms, p99 < 350ms end-to-end. Target throughput baseline: 200 req/s with spikes to 800 req/s for flash sales.
- Workloads: reranking (top-K), short-chat assistants (context windows 256 tokens max), embeddings for semantic match (batching for embedding compute), on-the-fly summarization for cart conversations.
- Model preferences: prefer quantized Llama- or MPT-family variants; open-models acceptable. Want automatic fallback to smaller variants during spikes.
- Optimization interest: batching policy tuning (dynamic batching with latency SLO enforcement), prefix/KV caching for repeat session-turns, 4-bit quantization experiments to reduce GPU memory & cost. Also want guidance on model kernels and kernel selection tradeoffs for different seq lengths.
- Perf benchmarking asks: request a standardized perf deck with: tokens/sec by model variant, latency percentiles by sequence length, throughput vs batch size curves, cost per 1M tokens for production mix, and tail-latency under realistic burst patterns. Also ask for example SLO config and autoscaler settings.

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2026-02-20: Intro call (Jordan) — product overview, disclosed latency targets. Action: send perf case study.
- 2026-02-26: Deep-dive with infra + ML (Priya) — data flow diagram, sample qps profiles. Action: SE to propose POC plan.
- 2026-03-01: Security kickoff (Diego + Legal) — SOC2 docs requested, start questionnaire. Action: customer to return completed form 3/8.
- 2026-03-04: Cost modelling session — rough estimates show Dedicated could cut cost by ~35% vs hosted at their scale; customer requests a measured bench.
- 2026-03-05: Agreement on POC scope: 2-week perf benchmark on Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) + 1-week integration into staging.

Quotes / call notes (verbatim/paraphrase):
- "We can't trade-off p95 for cost — user conversion drops if recommendation latency spikes."
- "If you can show consistent performance at 200rps with a 150ms p95 and quantized models, procurement signs faster."

POC plan (high level):
- Week 0: POA and infra prep — provide sample traffic traces, define success metrics (p95 latency, cost per 1k sessions, tail loss).
- Week 1-2: Dedicated perf bench — run sequences across 3 model variants (full FP16, int8 quant, 4-bit quant) with dynamic batching enabled; measure per-token cost, tail latency, and throughput. Provide perf report and config recommendations (batch sizes, autotune knobs, cache TTL).
- Week 3: Integration into staging — validate SDK integration, SSO flows, audit log shipping.

- Long-tail memory pressure for large KV caches during black-friday spikes — need profiling.
- Legal wants explicit list of sub-processors for private deployment.
